lines.zh: 我挂在森林的树皮缝里。
lines.en: I hang in a crevice of forest bark.
I shift gently with the trunk.
The wind turns me to another face.
I hide in the colour of the moss.
I have no feet; only silk holds me.
A crack in the bark fits me exactly.

lines.zh: 我一整天只挪了一点点。
lines.en: In a day I move only slightly.
Rain falls and I press to the tree.

lines.zh: 我从树皮的一边荡到另一边。
lines.en: I swing from one side of the bark to the other.

lines.zh: 这根树干归我用到羽化。
lines.en: This trunk is mine until I emerge.
I slide down a hair's breadth.
My silk hook winds around the wood.
As the shadow shifts, so do I.
I hide among the speckles; hard to find.

lines.zh: 森林里有很重的湿木味。
lines.en: The forest smells of wet wood.
I sway with the whole tree.
I cling to the bark, motionless.
There is a layer of dust on my shell.
I am well hidden here.

lines.zh: 苔藓把我和树干连在一起。
lines.en: The moss blends me into the trunk.
I am waiting for my wings to form.
A bird lands on the branch above.
All day, I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 森林的光是一块一块的。
lines.en: The forest light comes in patches.

lines.zh: 我的壳比叶子的颜色深。
lines.en: My shell is darker than the leaves.
I hear water moving inside the tree.
There are many kinds in this forest.
I change, slowly, slowly.
My shell is the color of bark.
I look too much like this bark.

lines.zh: 你别把我从树上弄下来。
lines.en: Do not take me off the tree.
Your face is too close.
You were looking for me a while, weren't you.
I am a peppered moth's cocoon.

lines.zh: 这片森林的树干都差不多。
lines.en: The trunks in this forest all look alike.
There are wood shavings on your hands.
Do not touch me with that blade.
I must stay inside a while longer.
A mark is knocked into my shell.
I am shaken loose in the crevice.
I swing hard but do not fall.
A small chip breaks off my hard shell.
The silk hook has loosened a little.
It is stifling inside.
I shrink myself as small as I can.
The whole tree rang with that.
I can only shrink a little.
I press myself into the grain of the bark.

lines.zh: 这一阶段我连嘴都没有。
lines.en: At this stage I have no mouth.
That will do you no good.
I do not feed at this stage.
That smell will attract other things.
Set it farther away.

lines.zh: 这个阶段，我对食物没兴趣。
lines.en: At this stage, food doesn't interest me.
That has nothing to do with me.
I need only to stay on the tree.
Don't wave it; it makes me dizzy.
Put it away; I wait to emerge.
The tree shook and so did I.
That scraped the moss off.
I knocked against the bark; no harm.
You hit the tree, not me.

lines.zh: 我从缝里被震出来一点。
lines.en: I am shaken a little out of the crack.
My silk still holds; don't worry.
I draw back into the crevice.
That shook off a good deal of dust.
Don't push the tree; I am not steady.
I swayed and nearly slipped off.
Not in this form.
The wings inside are still soft.
Right now I am only a cocoon.
Ask a piece of bark.
I cling to the bark and wait to emerge.
There are plenty of my kind in this forest.
The season of this tree has not come.

lines.zh: 这问题等蛾子出来再问。
lines.en: Ask that when the moth is out.
I retreat into the bark crevice.
This season, I don't do that.
Players cannot move me.

lines.zh: 你碰我，我只会更贴紧树。
lines.en: Touch me and I press tighter to the tree.
Don't dig; the bark will crumble.
You have grabbed wood.
I am hidden deep enough.
To take me you would have to peel the bark.
My silk is wound twice around.
Best you lower your hand.
This crevice is mine.

lines.zh: 没人能从这道树缝里抠走我。
lines.en: No one can pry me from this crevice.
Something is crawling on the trunk.

lines.zh: 我把身子转向那道影子。
lines.en: I turn my body toward that shadow.
It is coming up the bark.
I cannot move; I can only wait.
My speckles hide me in the tree shadow.
A beak stops a hand's width from me.
In the crack, I don't even pull silk.
Its feet are above me.
I listen to see if it stops.
It has gone on upward.
It moved around the far side.
My side happens to be in shadow.
Its shadow sweeps over my shell.
I press tighter than before.
It has come back.
I flatten my breathing to the thinnest.
It stops at the edge of the crack.
It sniffs and finds nothing.
It turns and goes down.
I wait until the tree stops sounding.
I am a cocoon; I can only endure.
It pecked the bark.
A small dent appears on my shell.
I curl the body inside tighter.
It struck wide and hit only wood.

lines.zh: 丝钩在木纹上磨得发响。
lines.en: My silk rasps on the wood grain.

lines.zh: 它停了一下，又试了一次。
lines.en: It paused, then tried again.
That left me reeling.
The pecking fades and I loosen my grip.
The shell is intact; good.
I formed a cocoon in a bark crevice.

lines.zh: 毛虫把我留在这棵树上。
lines.en: The caterpillar left me on this tree.
The forest light is broken up.

lines.zh: 我的壳和树干一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell is the same colour as the trunk.
This is the first time I hear woodpecking.
Wind passes through the canopy; cool.
The body inside has begun to twist.
The moss covers half of me nicely.
I hang neither high nor low.
Dark enough here, safe enough.

lines.zh: 火烤着树皮，我的壳发脆。
lines.en: Fire bakes the bark and my shell goes brittle.
I fall from the tree into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 雨水渗进壳里，里面湿透了。
lines.en: Rain seeps in and soaks the inside.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从树皮上撕下来。
lines.en: The blast rips me from the bark.

lines.zh: 箭扎穿了树皮，擦到我的壳。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the bark and grazes my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着木头传过来。
lines.en: That force travels through the wood.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可也撑不久。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I cannot last long.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I go numb.
The bark and I fall together.
